#!/usr/bin/env node
// Generated by scripts/build-exporter.mjs from src/move-in/collect/. Do not edit.
export function pagerdutyTasks(window) {
    return [
        { kind: 'users', path: '/users?limit=100&offset=0' },
        { kind: 'schedule-list', path: '/schedules?limit=100&offset=0' },
        { kind: 'escalation_policies', path: '/escalation_policies?limit=100&offset=0' },
    ];
}
export function pagerdutySchedule(id, window) {
    const path = '/schedules/' + encodeURIComponent(id);
    const dates = new URLSearchParams({ since: window.since, until: window.until });
    return [
        { kind: 'detail', path: `${path}?${dates}`, schedule: id },
        { kind: 'overrides', path: `${path}/overrides?${dates}&overflow=true`, schedule: id },
    ];
}
export function opsgenieTasks() {
    return [
        { kind: 'users', path: '/v2/users?limit=100&offset=0' },
        { kind: 'schedule-list', path: '/v2/schedules' },
        { kind: 'escalations', path: '/v2/escalations' },
    ];
}
export function opsgenieSchedule(id, window) {
    const path = '/v2/schedules/' + encodeURIComponent(id);
    const query = new URLSearchParams({ date: window.since, interval: String(window.days), intervalUnit: 'days' });
    return [
        { kind: 'detail', path, schedule: id },
        { kind: 'overrides', path: `${path}/overrides`, schedule: id },
        { kind: 'timelines', path: `${path}/timeline?${query}`, schedule: id },
    ];
}
export const collectionLimit = 'This read exceeds Oncall’s 500-object or 512 KiB import limit. Ask your administrator for a smaller provider access scope; do not truncate rotations or omit their people.';
export class CollectionRefusal extends Error {
}
const credentialField = /^(?:password|passwd|secret|token|credentials?|authorization|cookie)$|(?:api|access|auth|integration|routing|service|signing|private|client|refresh|session)[_-]?(?:key|secret|token)$|^webhook[_-]?(?:url|secret)$|(?:http|web)[_-]?cal[_-]?url$|^ical[_-]?url$/i;
export function exportWindow(start, end) {
    const parse = (value) => {
        if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value))
            throw new CollectionRefusal('Use dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.');
        const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`);
        if (!Number.isFinite(+date) || date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value)
            throw new CollectionRefusal('That calendar date does not exist.');
        return date;
    };
    const since = parse(start), until = parse(end), days = (+until - +since) / 86400000;
    if (days < 1 || days > 31)
        throw new CollectionRefusal('Choose an end date 1 to 31 days after the start date.');
    return { since: since.toISOString(), until: until.toISOString(), days };
}
export function defaultWindow() {
    return exportWindow(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10));
}
export function emptyBundle(vendor) {
    return { users: [], schedules: [], overrides: [], ...(vendor === 'opsgenie' ? { escalations: [], timelines: [] } : { escalation_policies: [] }) };
}
export const bundleJSON = (bundle) => JSON.stringify(bundle, null, 2) + '\n';
export const bundleCount = (bundle) => Object.values(bundle).reduce((n, records) => n + records.length, 0);
export function checkBundle(bundle) {
    if (bundleCount(bundle) > 500 || new TextEncoder().encode(bundleJSON(bundle)).length > 512 * 1024)
        throw new CollectionRefusal(collectionLimit);
}
function cleanResponse(value, key, removed) {
    if (typeof value === 'string' && value.includes(key))
        throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned the credential inside its data. Nothing was imported; ask your provider administrator for help.');
    if (Array.isArray(value))
        return value.map(item => cleanResponse(item, key, removed));
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object')
        return value;
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).flatMap(([field, child]) => {
        if (field.includes(key))
            throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned the credential inside its data. Nothing was imported; ask your provider administrator for help.');
        if (credentialField.test(field)) {
            removed.count++;
            return [];
        }
        return [[field, cleanResponse(child, key, removed)]];
    }));
}
export function providerOrigin(vendor, region) {
    if (!['pagerduty', 'opsgenie'].includes(vendor) || !['us', 'eu'].includes(region))
        throw new CollectionRefusal('Choose PagerDuty or Opsgenie and a US or EU account region.');
    return `https://api.${region === 'eu' ? 'eu.' : ''}${vendor}.com`;
}
// Read the body with a hard bound before JSON.parse. Neither provider bodies nor exceptions escape this boundary.
async function boundedJSON(response) {
    const reader = response.body?.getReader();
    if (!reader)
        throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned an empty answer. Nothing was imported.');
    const chunks = [];
    let size = 0;
    try {
        while (true) {
            const next = await reader.read();
            if (next.done)
                break;
            size += next.value.byteLength;
            if (size > 512 * 1024) {
                await reader.cancel();
                throw new CollectionRefusal(collectionLimit);
            }
            chunks.push(next.value);
        }
    }
    finally {
        reader.releaseLock();
    }
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const chunk of chunks) {
        bytes.set(chunk, offset);
        offset += chunk.byteLength;
    }
    try {
        return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
    }
    catch {
        throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned unreadable data. Nothing was imported.');
    }
}
/** A continuation is data only: the app seals it, binding it to this admin, source, region and expiry. No credential enters it. */
export async function collectStep(options, previous, budget = 40) {
    const { vendor, region, key, request = fetch, progress = () => { }, bearer = false } = options;
    const base = providerOrigin(vendor, region), ops = vendor === 'opsgenie';
    if (typeof key !== 'string' || !key.trim() || /\s/.test(key) || key.length > 4096)
        throw new CollectionRefusal('Paste only the read-only key, with no spaces or header text.');
    if (!Number.isInteger(budget) || budget < 1 || budget > 40)
        throw new CollectionRefusal('The read request budget is invalid.');
    const window = options.window ?? previous?.window ?? defaultWindow();
    const state = previous ? structuredClone(previous) : { tasks: ops ? opsgenieTasks() : pagerdutyTasks(window), bundle: emptyBundle(vendor), window, removed: 0 };
    const part = emptyBundle(vendor), removed = { count: state.removed };
    let requests = 0;
    function safeURL(path, initial) {
        const url = new URL(path, base);
        if (url.origin !== base || url.username || url.password || url.hash || (initial && url.pathname !== initial.pathname))
            throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned an unsafe pagination link. Nothing was imported.');
        return url;
    }
    while (state.tasks.length && requests < budget) {
        const task = state.tasks[0], initial = safeURL(task.path), visited = task.visited ?? [], identities = task.identities ?? [];
        if (visited.includes(initial.href) || visited.length >= 100)
            throw new CollectionRefusal('Provider pagination did not complete safely. Read again while settings are unchanged.');
        progress(`Reading ${task.kind === 'schedule-list' ? 'schedules' : task.kind}…`);
        const headers = { Authorization: ops ? `GenieKey ${key}` : bearer ? `Bearer ${key}` : `Token token=${key}`, Accept: ops ? 'application/json' : 'application/vnd.pagerduty+json;version=2' };
        const controller = new AbortController(), timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000);
        let body, response;
        try {
            requests++;
            response = await request(initial, { method: 'GET', headers, redirect: 'manual', signal: controller.signal });
            if (response.status >= 300 && response.status < 400)
                throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider redirected the read. Redirects are refused; check the account region. Nothing was imported.');
            if (!response.ok)
                throw new CollectionRefusal(response.status === 401 || response.status === 403 || response.status === 422
                    ? 'The provider refused this key. Check the account region and read-only configuration access. Nothing was imported.'
                    : response.status === 429 ? 'The provider’s rate limit was reached. Wait a few minutes and read again. Nothing was imported.' : 'The provider could not complete the read. Check its status and try again. Nothing was imported.');
            body = cleanResponse(await boundedJSON(response), key, removed);
        }
        catch (error) {
            // Only our fixed sentences are exposed; fetch failures may contain URLs, headers or credentials.
            if (error instanceof CollectionRefusal && !error.message.includes(key))
                throw error;
            throw new CollectionRefusal('Could not read the provider. Check your network, account region and provider status, then try again. Nothing was imported.');
        }
        finally {
            clearTimeout(timer);
        }
        if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || body.error || body.errors || body.result === false)
            throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned an error answer. Nothing was imported.');
        const list = !['detail', 'timelines'].includes(task.kind);
        let next = null;
        if (list) {
            const kind = task.kind === 'schedule-list' ? 'schedules' : task.kind;
            const items = body[ops ? 'data' : kind];
            if (!Array.isArray(items))
                throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned no record list. Nothing was imported.');
            for (const item of items) {
                const id = item?.id ?? item?.alias;
                if (id !== undefined && identities.includes(String(id)))
                    throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider repeated a record while paging. Read again while settings are unchanged.');
                if (id !== undefined)
                    identities.push(String(id));
            }
            if (task.kind === 'schedule-list') {
                if (identities.length > 500 || items.some((item) => !item?.id))
                    throw new CollectionRefusal(collectionLimit);
                // Details follow the complete schedule list, before policies, preserving the exporter's original order.
                const at = state.tasks.findIndex(t => ['escalations', 'escalation_policies'].includes(t.kind));
                state.tasks.splice(at < 0 ? state.tasks.length : at, 0, ...items.flatMap((item) => ops ? opsgenieSchedule(String(item.id), window) : pagerdutySchedule(String(item.id), window)));
            }
            else {
                const records = task.kind === 'overrides' ? items.map((item) => ({ ...item, [ops ? 'scheduleId' : 'schedule_id']: task.schedule })) : items;
                state.bundle[kind].push(...records);
                part[kind].push(...records);
            }
            if (ops)
                next = body.paging?.next || response.headers.get('x-paging-next') || null;
            else if (body.more === true) {
                if (!Number.isSafeInteger(body.limit) || body.limit < 1 || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.offset) || body.offset < 0 || !items.length)
                    throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned invalid pagination. Nothing was imported.');
                const url = new URL(initial);
                url.searchParams.set('offset', String(body.offset + body.limit));
                url.searchParams.set('limit', String(body.limit));
                next = url.href;
            }
            else if (!ops && initial.searchParams.has('limit') && body.more !== false)
                throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned no pagination status. Nothing was imported.');
        }
        else {
            const record = body[ops ? 'data' : 'schedule'];
            if (task.kind === 'detail' ? !record || String(record.id) !== task.schedule : !record?.finalTimeline || String(record._parent?.id) !== task.schedule)
                throw new CollectionRefusal('The provider returned details for a different schedule. Nothing was imported.');
            const kind = task.kind === 'detail' ? 'schedules' : 'timelines';
            state.bundle[kind].push(record);
            part[kind].push(record);
        }
        checkBundle(state.bundle);
        // Bound index metadata too, before it can enter a continuation.
        if (new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(state.tasks)).length > 512 * 1024)
            throw new CollectionRefusal(collectionLimit);
        if (next) {
            const url = safeURL(next, initial);
            task.path = url.href;
            task.visited = [...visited, initial.href];
            task.identities = identities;
        }
        else
            state.tasks.shift();
    }
    state.removed = removed.count;
    if (!state.tasks.length && !bundleCount(state.bundle))
        throw new CollectionRefusal('The account returned no importable records. Check key access and region. Nothing was imported.');
    return { part, next: state.tasks.length ? state : null, state, requests };
}
export async function collectExport(options) {
    let state;
    do {
        const result = await collectStep(options, state);
        state = result.state;
    } while (state.tasks.length);
    return { json: bundleJSON(state.bundle), count: bundleCount(state.bundle), removed: state.removed };
}

import { createInterface } from 'node:readline/promises'
import { Writable } from 'node:stream'
import { writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { resolve } from 'node:path'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'


const vendors = ['opsgenie', 'pagerduty']
const day = 86400000

async function question(label, hidden = false) {
 const silent = new Writable({ write(_chunk, _encoding, done) { done() } })
 const rl = createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: hidden ? silent : process.stdout, terminal: true, historySize: 0 })
 // A closed prompt is never treated as Enter/default, including Ctrl-C during hidden input.
 let answered = false
 rl.on('SIGINT', () => { process.stderr.write('Export cancelled. No file was saved.\n'); process.exitCode = 1; rl.close() })
 if (hidden) process.stdout.write(label)
 try {
  const value = await rl.question(hidden ? '' : label)
  answered = true
  return value.trim()
 } finally {
  rl.close()
  if (hidden) process.stdout.write('\n')
  if (!answered) process.exitCode = 1
 }
}

async function main() {
 if (Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]) < 22) throw Error('Install Node.js 22 or later, then run this command again.')
 if (process.argv.length === 3 && ['--help', '-h'].includes(process.argv[2])) {
  console.log('Usage: node oncall-export.mjs opsgenie|pagerduty\nRequires Node 22+ and an interactive terminal. Prompts for us/eu region, UTC comparison dates (1–31 days), and a hidden read-only API key.\nGET requests only; no packages or uploads. Collects all accessible records, follows pagination and joins schedule details/overrides.\nSaves PROVIDER-export-DATE-TIME.json in the current folder only after collection, credential removal and the 512 KiB/500-object checks succeed.\nUpload that file under Settings → Move in → Other: from a file → Review. Paging stays OFF.');
  return
 }
 const vendor = process.argv[2]
 if (!vendors.includes(vendor) || process.argv.length !== 3) throw Error('Usage: node oncall-export.mjs opsgenie  OR  node oncall-export.mjs pagerduty')
 if (!process.stdin.isTTY || !process.stdout.isTTY) throw Error('Run in an interactive terminal so the key can be entered without echo. Do not pipe or redirect this command.')
 console.log(`Oncall ${vendor} export: GET requests only. The API key stays in this process.`)
 const region = (await question('Account region (us/eu) [us]: ')) || 'us'
 if (!['us', 'eu'].includes(region)) throw Error('Region must be us or eu. Run again.')
 const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
 const start = (await question(`Comparison start, UTC date [${today}]: `)) || today
 const defaultEnd = new Date(Date.parse(`${start}T00:00:00Z`) + 14 * day)
 if (!Number.isFinite(+defaultEnd)) throw Error('Use a valid YYYY-MM-DD start date. Run again.')
 const end = (await question(`Comparison end, UTC date [${defaultEnd.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}]: `)) || defaultEnd.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
 const window = exportWindow(start, end)
 const key = await question('Paste read-only API key (input hidden), then press Enter: ', true)
 const result = await collectExport({ vendor, region, key, window, progress: line => console.log(line) })
 const filename = resolve(`${vendor}-export-${new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':', '-')}.json`)
 try { await writeFile(filename, result.json, { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 }) }
 catch { throw Error('Could not save the export. Check folder permissions and free disk space, then run again.') }
 console.log(`Saved ${filename}\n${result.count} objects; ${result.removed} credential fields omitted.\nCoverage comparison: ${window.since} to ${window.until}.`)
 console.log('Return to Settings → Move in. Choose Other: from a file and select this file to open Review. Review every rejection and difference; export success does not establish compatibility. Paging stays OFF.')
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
 main().catch(error => { console.error(`Export stopped: ${error.message}`); process.exitCode = 1 })
}
